articles.title: HSBC rolls out its first stablecoin to over 3 million everyday app users
articles.snippet: HSBC and Standard Chartered-led Anchorpoint received Hong Kong’s first stablecoin issuer licenses in April. Anchorpoint began rolling out HKDAP in August.

articles.title: Bitcoin slides below $82,000 as AI doubts return, with DeFi tokens leading declines
articles.snippet: Bitcoin as much as 2.9% to around $81,600 as Nasdaq futures dropped, while the CoinDesk 80 lost 3.5% and DeFi index slid 6%.

articles.title: Cysic dangles a 10% bounty, hacker pours loot into Tornado Cash
articles.snippet: The attacker moved $744,000 in ETH and BNB to Tornado Cash after exploiting Cysic’s bridge to mint 10 million tokens on BNB Smart Chain.

articles.title: Bybit secures first full Dubai license for spot trading services
articles.snippet: Bybit’s new VARA licence authorizes spot trading services in Dubai, but the exchange must complete additional regulatory requirements before launching.

articles.title: ChatGPT Teaches Messi Chess—On a Board It Set Up Wrong, With an Opening That Loses in Four Moves
articles.snippet: Lionel Messi’s ChatGPT ad has the AI teaching him chess on a board with kings and queens swapped, then suggesting an opening that loses in four moves on that board.
